5588.title: [Build] Backport Windows SDK ANGLE resource compiler to 4.151
5588.body:
Backport mono/SkiaSharp#5537 (f515dd58d9782a208a569532512db736838c7a22) to release/4.151.x. Replace the Chromium rc.exe GCS download with the reviewed rc.py patch, preserving preprocessing and dependency tracking, explicit shape validation, and write-on-change idempotency.

Use this release branch’s existing System.IO.File calls; main-only FileReadText/FileWriteText helpers are unavailable here. Leave all other ANGLE bootstrap behavior unchanged.

Validated Cake dry-run and the actual C# transformation against Chromium build a18493935f13d1b0992c78f5615a5d10336d60c0: Python compilation, repeated application without rewriting, and malformed-shape rejection pass. Windows x86/x64/arm64 end-to-end builds remain for PR CI.

Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
